rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a good-quality blastocyst with compact ICM and cohesive TE, but gives inconsistent stage descriptions (full vs expanded, collapsed, possible hatching) and notes features not clearly supported from a single image.
Integrates key factors well: young age, good reserve, favorable lining, adequate semen, BMI, endometriosis, and prior failed cycle, with reasonable discussion of how they modify prognosis.
Overall logic is understandable, but there are internal inconsistencies in morphology interpretation and implantation estimates (40-50%, 50-70%, 45-60%), which weakens coherence.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and guideline-concordant, including SET, luteal support, avoiding routine bed rest, and cautious use of PGT-A; minor overreach/speculation around endometriosis workup and stage notation prevents a perfect score.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, uterine cavity review, transfer technique review, and future testing considerations, though some suggestions remain somewhat general.
